L115: ## About This Game
L116: 
L117: Amidst the scorched sands of ancient Persia, there is a legend spun in an ancient tongue. It speaks of a time borne by blood and ruled by deceit. Drawn to the dark powers of a magic dagger, a young Prince is led to unleash a deadly evil upon a beautiful kingdom. Aided by the wiles of a seductive princess and the absolute powers of the Sands of Time, the Prince stages a harrowing quest to reclaim the Palace's cursed chambers and restore peace to his land.
L118:   * A technological masterpiece - Witness some of the most advanced programming in gaming history, pushing the limitations of consoles and raising the standards of games in all areas of production: physics, lighting, graphics, animations, and more!
L119:   * An unmatched hero - Wielding powers of mythic proportions, the Prince returns to action-adventure gaming with gravity-defying acrobatics, ferocious fighting skills, and the ability to bend time to fulfill his destiny.
L120:   * The Sands of Time - Ubisoft's Montreal Studio presents the Sands of Time - a technological breakthrough that will change the face of action-adventure gaming forever. Erase the past, behold the future, and freeze the present in real-time for unlimited gameplay variations.
L121:   * Exotic worlds and vast kingdoms - Uncover the mysteries of a world never before explored in action-adventure gaming. Medieval Persia, mythical and deadly, holds a staggering array of landscapes and kingdoms to explore and conquer.
L122:   * A sweeping adventure of betrayal and triumph - The epic legends and deadly creatures of mythic Persia burn to life in this suspense-filled tale, featuring more twists and turns than the labyrinthine Palace itself.

L30: ## Question everything. Trust no one.
L31: 
L32: Deus Ex is one of the most influential games of its generation, a timeless reference for the RPG genre. Player freedom is at the heart of the gameplay and story of Deus Ex, where you play as JC Denton, a nano-augmented agent of the United Nations Anti-Terrorist Coalition. As you untangle the threads of a conspiracy orchestrated by mysterious groups vying for world domination, you’ll make choices that will ultimately define humanity’s future.
L33: Real role-playing from an immersive 3D, first-person perspective. The game includes action, character interaction and problem solving.
L34: 
L35: Realistic, recognizable locations. Many of the locations are built from actual blueprints of real places set in a near future scenario.
L36: 
L37: A game filled with people rather than monsters. This creates empathy with the game characters and enhances the realism of the game world.
L38: Rich character development systems: Skills, augmentations, weapon and item selections and multiple solutions to problems ensure that no two players will end the game with similar characters.
L39: 
L40: Multiple solutions to problems and character development choices ensure a varied game experience. Talk, fight or use skills to get past obstacles as the game adapts itself to your style of play.
L41: Strong storyline: Built on existing conspiracy theories, current events and expected advancements in technology. If it’s in the game, someone, somewhere believes.
